The only computer use API you will ever need.

An entire computer, made as a single API.

Start with the outcome and take control only when you need it. Hand Coasty the whole task, or take any layer back: the plan, the machine, the loop itself. Nothing is rewritten when you change your mind, because every level shares the same keys, the same actions, and the same model underneath.
